# Navego

Drive your own signed-in browser from an MCP client — no cloud hop, no exported session, one npm install.

## One command to try

```bash
npm i -g navego
navego auth     # sign in once; the token stays on this machine
navego doctor   # prints bridge, device, plan, quota — the fix when degraded
```

From any MCP client:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "navego": { "command": "navego", "args": ["local"] }
  }
}
```

## What it does

- 40 `browser_*`/`artifact_*`/`delivery_*`/`wallet_*` tools over the loopback bridge — your own everyday browser, Canvas/UI paths (Google Sheets, Docs), plus the meter your plan pays for.
- Reads pages, clicks, types, navigates, downloads artifacts, records sessions.
- Publisher: `afnannuzulasugihartono/navego` (GitHub). Package: `navego` (npm). License: MIT.Protocol 1, 36-primitive wire allowlist.

## What it does not do

- Does not send browsing traffic to a remote browser or cloud driver.
- Does not bypass paywalls, captchas, sign-in walls, or rate limits — nothing does and this cannot.
- Does not run per-site code or free `eval` in the browser.

## Docs

- `README.md` — product boundary, boundary rules, runtime contract.
- `docs/agent-friendly.md` — per-client copy-paste setup for Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, Cherry Studio.
- `docs/agent-call.md` — env vars, metering, PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED behavior, § the meter.
- `docs/api.md` — the 36 primitives and the wire contract.
- `docs/releases/` — release notes by version.
- `ARCHITECTURE.md` / `AGENTS.md` — repo layout and the rules the repo enforces.
- `SECURITY.md` — private vulnerability disclosure route.

## Fast facts for agents

- Claim a tab before any action: `browser_tabs_list`, then act on the `tabId` you claim; never guess a tab id.
- Your first call should be `browser_get_guide` — it returns the 42 tools as tasks, not a list you have to read.
- `browser_read_page` answers with the measured text and says `settled: null` when one sample cannot say yet; pair with `browser_wait_until`.
- Google Sheets / Docs render to canvas; there is no element to write to or text to read back. The SERP/MEMO delivery kits cover the Google flow; the docs do not invent credentials for you.
- `navego doctor` is the one command to reach for — its verdict names the fix.
- `PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED` answers with the plan name; upgrade in the dashboard, not in code.
